2125261676521943163.en_summary: Couzin_Vinny analyzes $WMT with @spotgamma tools. As long as WMT holds above the prior swing high ($131.82), the path of least resistance points toward the $135 Call Wall, where dealer hedging flows will begin to cap upside momentum. Previous call wall was $125, shifts higher after #opex. Any cooling of RSI 71 +/- should find initial buyers near yesterday's high ($130.52) and the $130 psychological level. The Hedge Wall at $127—aligned closely with the 20-day SMA ($126.44)—marks the key volatility trigger; only a break below $127 would shift dealers back into a destabilizing negative-gamma regime.
2125261676521943163.zh_summary: Couzin_Vinny 使用 @spotgamma 工具分析 $WMT。只要 WMT 維持在先前擺動高點（131.82 美元）之上，最小阻力路徑指向 135 美元看漲牆，交易商對沖流將開始限制上行動能。先前看漲牆是 125 美元，在 #opex 後上移。任何 RSI 71 +/- 冷卻應在昨日高點（130.52 美元）和 130 美元心理水平找到初始買家。對沖牆在 127 美元——與 20 日 SMA（126.44 美元）密切對齊——標誌著關鍵波動觸發；只有跌破 127 美元才會將交易商轉回不穩定的負 gamma 制度。

ticker_notes.WMT: above $131.82 to $135 Call Wall, Hedge Wall $127
